proposals.scope: Predeclare a small set of native sender/receiver opportunity windows and fixed private controllers; measure delivered-vs-lost information value and actual imaging/downlink alternatives in every window. Retain negative and neutral cases.
proposals.acceptance: Find and independently reproduce at least one positive net case and one nonpositive case before a learning-efficacy experiment; no seed or window search promoted as representative performance

proposals.status: Already implemented opt-in; not promoted to baseline
proposals.evidence: Conserves the team science sum; sends one fourth of receiver science to sender and idle bystanders. Physical ownership and local penalties stay local.
proposals.remaining_problem: In the tested path, 289 seconds and one lambda transition reduce 0.1971/4 to 0.003647. Reward sharing does not recover foregone physical imaging value.

proposals.status: Separate scientific ablation requiring explicit approval
proposals.evidence: The unchanged AMOS gamma has an approximately 81-second half-life. Altering it changes the objective and checkpoint contract.
proposals.recommendation: Do not choose a gamma to manufacture a desired communication result. Compare objectives only after defining the operational value/time horizon.

proposals.protocol_requirements: Explicit new versioned packet/observation contract; requests pay declared physical contact, pointing, duration and payload costs. No private task/intent added to ideal navigation beacons.
